claim_boundary: Exact installed Desktop 1.40609 main-process source, sliced by unique markers and executed in isolation with synthetic inputs.

The @ant/claude-native addon binary is not part of the reviewed tree; its getWindowsElevationType() string enum is pinned from the two JS consumers (default | limited | full; anything else is treated as unknown by getSystemInfo).
Not a capture value proof: the captured schema holds field names only; native source decides key order and values.
The gateway emits only the events listed under executable_events; every other lane event stays a boundary with its native condition.

slices.begin: async function gk(e,t){let n=await FPt(e,t);return gPt(`refresh`,n,e),n}

derivations.elevation_type: maybeGetClaudeNative()?.getWindowsElevationType() ?? `default`; addon enum default | limited | full mirrors TOKEN_ELEVATION_TYPE (TokenElevationTypeDefault=1, TokenElevationTypeFull=2, TokenElevationTypeLimited=3) of the process token

executable_events.condition: app-ready handler of the main process, once per application launch, unconditionally (no platform gate); a throw inside the try suppresses the event (P.error `Failed to detect Windows elevation type`)
executable_events.lifecycle_position: application activation: after the account-details listener (oAr()) and before fcn()/Chrome extension bridge enablement; independent of any session, therefore before the first session event of that launch and before the autoUpdater checking-for-update event (desktop_update_check_started) which is only triggered later by the updater
executable_events.emulated_state: the gateway emulates one Desktop main process per enrolled account on Windows and reads the real process token (OpenProcessToken + GetTokenInformation(TokenElevationType)) once per account activation

derivations.oauth_type: gPt call-site literal: `refresh` (gk -> FPt token refresh) or `initial` (_k -> LPt cookie/authorize exchange); the gateway only refreshes
derivations.failure_reason: result.type of the flow; refresh flow (FPt): network_error (token POST threw), server_error (status >= 500), auth_error (status !== 200 and < 500)
derivations.status: present only when `status` in result: the HTTP status of the non-200 token response (server_error / auth_error); absent for network_error
derivations.client: `cowork_3p_hybrid` only when config.scope === `user:profile org:desktop_config`; the gateway refresh scope is user:inference, so never present

executable_events.condition: gPt(e,t,n) with !lk(t) i.e. the result has no `token` key; the refresh flow returns a typed failure instead of throwing for transport errors and non-200 responses (a response-body parse failure in KO throws and logs nothing)
executable_events.lifecycle_position: application-level, no session; on every failed token refresh
executable_events.emulated_state: the gateway refreshes the Desktop OAuth token via POST /v1/oauth/token (grant_type refresh_token, scope user:inference); transport failure => network_error, non-2xx => server_error/auth_error with status; other errors are not reported

pinned_boundaries.condition: KS(e,t): OS() && t !== undefined, deduped per `${feature_hash}:${on}:${source}` for the process lifetime; t is the GrowthBook FeatureResult of a subscribed/evaluated feature
pinned_boundaries.reason: the OS() gate and the GrowthBook FeatureResult.source of the Desktop main-process feature evaluation are not modelled by claudefeatures (its Lookup returns values without a GrowthBook source); stays a boundary

boundaries.reason: renderer-reported (index2 chunk qt(e,n)): {attempt_id, list_source:`local`, entry_point, attempt_index, duration_ms, session_count, skipped_count (only when store status loaded), cached:!1, store_state:n.status} from the UI session-list store outcome; the gateway has no renderer session-list load

index2 chunk: {session_id, preflight_ms, worktree_ms, mcp_ms, query_ms, enqueue_ms, init_ms, init_awake_ms, first_assistant_ms, ...} are performance marks of the real CLI spawn phases (n.sleepAtMark enqueue/init); the gateway spawns no CLI
warm-lifecycle idle timer outcomes (hasActiveQuery, remoteControlEnabled) of the CCD session manager; the gateway only models idle_timeout_started at app quit
index2 chunk: emitted when a warm (re)spawn starts after cliGovernor.acquireSlot(`warm`) ({session_id, is_ssh, backend_kind}) and completes; the gateway has no warm re-spawn

main chunk e_r(): {outcome, duration_ms, key_count, organization_id} after the remote managed-settings RPC race with a timeout, suppressed for outcome `no_org`; the gateway performs no managed-settings fetch

index2 chunk checkWorkspaceTrustUncached(e,n): {trust_check_cause:n, trust_total_ms:Math.round(performance.now()-r)} measures a real workspace trust lookup with dangerous-feature scan; no workspace trust check exists in the gateway

main chunk qrn(e): {...e, config_read_ms, config_parse_ms|null, config_rpc_ms|null} rounded measurements of a real config file re-read (cause self_write | external | initial); the gateway re-reads no Desktop config file

index2 chunk transcriptLease onPassResult: {candidates, renewed, fresh, missing, errors, skipped?, retention_days?, retention_source?} counts of a lease pass over the on-disk Desktop transcript store the gateway does not hold
index2 chunk CliGovernor.acquire(): fires only when effective CLI process count >= cap ({reason, cap, ...inflight, victim_idle_seconds, total_mem_gb, evicted}); the gateway runs no CLI processes

index2 chunk vn(e,n)/yn(e): renderer-reported switch telemetry ({session_id clamped, switch_id, session_type, is_new_session, entry_point, renderer_surface, backend_kind, renderer_build_id} / {..., reason, elapsed_ms, nav_temp, was_hidden}); nobody switches sessions in the gateway UI
index2 chunk: {session_id, cli_session_id, outcome, timed_out_phase, resolve_ms, scan_ms, stat_ms, copy_ms, total_ms} of the resume transcript relocation before spawn; not performed by the gateway
route/verdict/outcome come from the remote-control auto-enable policy and its RPC result; remote control is not modelled

main chunk Qun(): {transport: e.bridgeConfig?`bridge`:`socket`, bridge_url_present, is_nest_build:!1, platform} once when the Chrome extension bridge transport is first created (shouldEnableChromeExtensionBridge()); the gateway hosts no extension bridge
emitted by initBuddy() of the lazily loaded hardware-buddy chunk (index.chunk-C45MTFpl.js) for a real HID device; none exists in the gateway
main chunk vJn(e,t): {no_tpm_probe_code: NTE_*/0x code token ?? `no-code-token`} only when the device-registry TPM probe threw; the gateway performs no TPM key probe
